findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

The observed window is the score-time grid 0.0-0.49 with learning window [0.0,0.5] and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for this study.

Continuous contrast functions for landmark_00 features are non-monotone across the observed support: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z +9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00, and landmark_00_local_dy shows 6 sign changes with first_rate_z -72.37 and last_rate_z +5.52, so a constant rule is not supported over the full window.

Several landmark_00 local descriptors carry strong sign conflicts (landmark_00_local_dx: 9 strong_sign_conflicts, 6 sign changes; landmark_00_local_dz: 7 strong_sign_conflicts, 10 sign changes) and no polynomial fit was accepted, so these marginal descriptors are not reproducible enough to prioritize as coordinate rules.

Whole-window z values for the read landmark_00 features are small in magnitude (e.g. soft_mass 0.64, local_dx -0.18, local_dy -0.30, local_dz -0.02, local_cxx -0.58, local_cyy -0.58), so the endpoint-coordinate evidence does not establish a large net whole-window effect for these features.

hypotheses.falsifier: A validated fit or observed-node interpolation showing no sign change in the rate over the observed support.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast across observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule for landmark_00_soft_mass, rather than a constant rule, better describes the observed support because its rate changes sign within the window.

hypotheses.falsifier: Independent-batch agreement with no strong sign conflicts for these features over the observed support.
hypotheses.observable: sign_changes and strong_sign_conflicts for landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dz
hypotheses.statement: Marginal landmark_00 local displacement descriptors (dx, dz) should not be prioritized as coordinate rules because of strong sign conflicts and rejected polynomial fits.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit, and the immediate-selection versus descendant-credit comparison is unavailable.

Only the first six continuous_trends rows were read; the remaining 194 rows, branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects and turnover_accounting tables were not inspected, so uncertainty/multiplicity ranking, joint-pose separation and turnover accounting are not established here.
No independent-batch counterexample or opposing-observation check beyond the reported sign-conflict counts was performed.
No registered reward recipe was evaluated as an intervention; the hypotheses remain descriptive of the supplied coordinate contrasts.
